999008199.text: 離せ！　く……
あったわ。これ、もらうわね

localizations.en: Found it. I'll be taking this.

999008199.text: で、これどうする？　私が持っとく？

localizations.en: So, what should we do with this? Want me to hold onto it?

999008199.text:
壊しちゃおう。仮説が確かなら、これが
石の司令塔の役目を果たしているはずだし

localizations.en: Let's destroy it. If our theory is correct, this must be acting as the control center for the stones.

999008199.text: 了解

こ、これで操られていた人たちは
自由になったのかな……

localizations.en: D-does this mean everyone who was being controlled is free now...?

999008199.text:
コイツがみんなを操っていたんだったら、
そのはずだが

localizations.en: If this guy was the one controlling everyone, then yeah, should be.

999008199.text: 俺が……操る？　違う！　俺じゃない！

localizations.en: Me... controlling them? No! It wasn't me!

999008199.text: あぁ！？　言い逃れようったって、そうはいかねぇぞ！

localizations.en: Hah?! Don't think you can talk your way out of this!

999008199.text:
みんなを操ってブレスレットを作らせて、
お賃金を踏み倒した恨みは忘れないわよ？

localizations.en: Don't think we've forgotten how you controlled everyone to make those bracelets without pay.

999008199.text: 信じてくれ！　石を拾ってから操られてたんだ！

localizations.en: Please, believe me! I've been controlled ever since I picked up that stone!

999008199.text: 何が起きたのか、話してもらえますか？

localizations.en: Could you tell us what happened?

999008199.text:
あ、ああ。島についた俺たちは、数日してから
ようやく流れ星を見つけ、持ち帰ろうとしたんだ

localizations.en: Y-yes. After we arrived on the island, it took us several days to find the shooting star. We tried to bring it back...

999008199.text:
だが、いくらかの欠片に砕き、みんなで
運んでいたその時、急に辺りに青い粒子が漂い始めた

localizations.en: But when we broke it into pieces and started carrying them, suddenly blue particles began floating around us.

999008199.text:
その瞬間――強烈な怒りと憎しみに
心を塗りつぶされ、支配されたんだ

localizations.en: In that moment, my mind was overwhelmed with intense anger and hatred. I lost control.

999008199.text:
怒りと……憎しみね。他に何か、変わったことは
あった？

localizations.en: Anger and... hatred, huh. Did anything else unusual happen?

999008199.text:
ああ。そういえばその時、空から大きな影が
落ちてたな

localizations.en: Yeah... Now that I think about it, I saw a large shadow fall from the sky.

999008199.text:
影はこっちを見つめてた。目が合うと、
にいって微笑んだんだ……

localizations.en: The shadow was watching us. When our eyes met, it... it smiled...

999008199.text: ……アタシ、分かった気がする……全部逆だったんだ

localizations.en: ...I think I understand now. We had it all backwards.

999008199.text: アルビーナ？

この状況を企んだ奴は、ノーヴァ神聖国を
強く恨んで、復讐したいと願ってた

localizations.en: The one behind all this harbored a deep grudge against Nova, seeking revenge.

999008199.text:
そこで石の力を使って、島に来た調査団を。
さらに神官長を使って国民全員を操ろうとしたんだ

localizations.en: They used the stones' power to control the survey team, then the High Priest, trying to manipulate everyone in the nation.

999008199.text:
ま、まさか。そんなことを企てるほど、国に恨みを
抱いてる奴なんて

localizations.en: N-no way. Who could possibly hold such a grudge against the nation...

999008199.text:
そう。今までの事件で、いつも顔を出してた存在。
そいつはツォルンフルク！

localizations.en: The one who's been showing up during all these incidents. It's Zornfalk!

999008199.text:
ツォルンフルクは、自分をこの島に追いやった
国と人間たちを強く恨んでる

localizations.en: Zornfalk deeply resents the nation and the people who exiled them to this island.

999008199.text: これは、その復讐だ
